facts.fact: Cathedral belongs to the UNESCO Arab-Norman series from2015.
Cathedral visitor access distinguishes a freely entered area and the ticketed Monumental Area.
facts.excerpt: la prima a libero ingresso e la seconda detta "Area Monumentale" ad accesso con ticket

facts.fact: The monumental collection includes royal tombs, treasury and crypt; they are different from a quick exterior visit.
facts.excerpt: Tesoro della Cattedrale dove insieme ai preziosi arredi liturgici

facts.fact: The crypt includes tombs of the archbishops.
facts.excerpt: Cripta dove sono custodite le tombe degli Arcivescovi di Palermo

title: Palermo Cathedral — the monument and visit areas
